#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

int countUnique(const std::vector<int>& array, int startIdx, int endIdx) {
    bool seenColors[24];
    std::memset(seenColors, false, sizeof(seenColors));
    int uniqueCount = 0;
    for (int i = startIdx; i <= endIdx; i++) {
        int color = array[i];
        if (!seenColors[color]) {
            seenColors[color] = true;
            uniqueCount++;
        }
    }
    return uniqueCount;
}

int main() {
    int a, b, l, r;
    std::cin >> a >> b >> l >> r;
    l -= 1;
    r -= 1;
    int totalAB = a + b;
    int repeatTimes = 4;
    std::vector<int> patternArr(totalAB * repeatTimes);
    int shiftH = l / totalAB;
    l -= shiftH * totalAB;
    r -= shiftH * totalAB;
    int segmentSize = (r - l + 1) / totalAB;
    if (segmentSize > 2) r -= (segmentSize - 2) * totalAB;
    int deltaVal = std::max(a - b, 1);
    for (int repIdx = 0; repIdx < repeatTimes; repIdx++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < a - deltaVal; k++)
            patternArr[totalAB * repIdx + k] = k;
        for (int k = 0; k < deltaVal; k++)
            patternArr[totalAB * repIdx + a - deltaVal + k] = (repIdx % 2 == 0) ? a - deltaVal + k : a + k;
    }
    int minColorsNeeded = a + a;
    for (int shiftAIdx = 1; shiftAIdx <= deltaVal; shiftAIdx++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < b; k++)
            patternArr[a + k] = patternArr[a - shiftAIdx];
        for (int shiftBIdx1 = 1; shiftBIdx1 <= deltaVal; shiftBIdx1++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < b; k++)
                patternArr[totalAB + a + k] = patternArr[totalAB + a - shiftBIdx1];
            for (int shiftBIdx2 = 1; shiftBIdx2 <= deltaVal; shiftBIdx2++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < b; k++)
                    patternArr[2 * totalAB + a + k] = patternArr[2 * totalAB + a - shiftBIdx2];
                for (int shiftBIdx3 = 1; shiftBIdx3 <= deltaVal; shiftBIdx3++) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < b; k++)
                        patternArr[3 * totalAB + a + k] = patternArr[3 * totalAB + a - shiftBIdx3];
                    minColorsNeeded = std::min(minColorsNeeded, countUnique(patternArr, l, r));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    std::cout << minColorsNeeded << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
